card.name: Start of numbers in dates and doses
card.fires_on: The space or first digit just before a number, mostly day-of-month in dates (On 1 July, Jan. 16, On 25 December) and amounts after 'at' or 'than' (at 25 mg, no more than 1 mg).

modes.label: Day in a date
modes.description: The space or first digit of a day number after a month or 'On'.

modes.label: Dose amount
modes.description: The space or unit right at the start of a dose figure.

modes.label: Other openers
modes.description: Scattered spots right before a quote or place name.

card.plain: It fires at the spot where a date's day number or a dose number is about to begin.
